verdict.rationale: Fireworks has a dedicated batch inference guide that processes large volumes of requests asynchronously at a documented 50% off Serverless per-token prices, which covers both the async submission and the explicit discount. The community pricing complaint is about fine-tuning, not batch inference, so it is ignored. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of batch job submission and the discount in practice, and detail on the job workflow (completion windows, input formats).
